notes: Adds MOTIF genre selection, scale lock across presets, a master output limiter, and revised factory preset levels. Fixes preset latency during playback, host-synced modulation phase, master automation display updates, and AUX controls with dual assignments. Includes universal macOS AU/VST3, Windows x64 VST3, Linux x86_64 VST3, and a full changelog since 501 on the beta portal.
